notes: MIT OpenCourseWare (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). OCW links "(PDF)" to an HTML resource page that holds the file, hence maxDepth 1. MIT OCW mathematics (18.xxx, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): lecture-notes, assignments, problem-set, exam and solution index pages for 98 further courses (plus assignments/exams pages of the 18 already seeded courses), all verified 200 and linking OCW resource pages (depth 1 reaches the PDFs). Selected from the OCW per-course sitemaps; calculus/ODE service courses, video-only and CS-theory courses left out. ocw.mit.edu robots.txt allows all.

courses.maths.ox.ac.uk is a Moodle LMS and its robots.txt disallows /pluginfile.php/, where the course PDFs live, so it is not crawled. Public people.maths.ox.ac.uk teaching pages: Norbury (applied analysis notes and sheets) and M. Giles (Monte Carlo, AIMS numerical methods, CUDA and OpenMP lectures). Lackenby, Lauder, Suli home pages are research-heavy and were skipped; courses.maths.ox.ac.uk is a login LMS (not used); gilesm/fd/ and batty answer 403.

davidtong.org is David Tong's (DAMTP) own site. damtp/user/examples holds the Tripos example sheets. DAMTP faculty pages (Dunajski, Skinner AQFT, Iserles numerical analysis IB/II, Hall, Sperhake GW-numerical-relativity notes) plus the Part III example-sheet index. www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk and www.statslab.cam.ac.uk fail TLS verification from the container (curl exit 60/000), so DPMMS/Statslab pages were not usable; maths.cam.ac.uk tripos-specific-resources mostly links dpmms.

www.math.harvard.edu answers 403 to the crawler. Faculty course pages on people.math.harvard.edu: McMullen (courses.html indexes ~25 per-course pages, each with course.pdf notes; depth 1 follows them), Ullery (Math 101/122/131/137/221 notes and problem sets), Elkies (Math 55a/55b problem sets and notes, 8 course years), Lurie Math 131. Verified 200 HTML and PDFs reachable; robots.txt only disallows /run. Excluded: Auroux pages (403), student-written notes (Achenjang, Landesman). Roughly 400+ PDFs available, so maxPdfs raised to 200. New round: more Knill course pages (Math 1a/22b/136/154/E-320/summer exams, 2022-2026), Auroux Math 112 (2019) and Collins Math 112 (2015) pages, and people.math.harvard.edu/archive Math 21a homework pages (2014-2017). All 200 HTML with PDFs reachable; robots only disallows /run. Blocked: ~yau 403; knill math22a2018/22b2019 pages have some 403 PDFs. www.math.harvard.edu not tried (403 per earlier note).

Princeton course pages (Prywes MAT 201 lecture notes, MAT 215, MAT 320, FRS; A. Chang MAT 215 homework; Fick MAT 204; Johnson MAT 202B old exams), each linking ~5-22 PDFs. Page links use www.math.princeton.edu, which 301-redirects to web.math.princeton.edu. Skipped: ~rvan/ home page (mixes lecture notes with research papers and talks), ~aionescu and ~aaa and ~ssaid (403), ~smorel and ~jkileel (moved away). web.math robots.txt only disallows /math_alive/ problem pages. Gunning's Math 218 analysis notes/book page and Math Alive syllabus (lectures, labs, problem sets). Princeton is thin: ~aionescu, ~aleksandrs, ~mmzhang, ~sd, ~zhanghz, ~cmiao, ~ytzhang, ~hjacobs, ~fefferman, ~dabramov, ~mbraverm, ~bjohnston, ~jm2007 all 403; ~rvan, ~naor mix papers with notes so skipped.

Math 230A/Stat 310A (Montanari, Dembo lecture notes lnotes.pdf, homework, practice exams), Math 205A real analysis files and homework, Math 230B/Stat 310B homework solutions, Math 51H and 52H honors calculus handouts; all on web.stanford.edu, all verified 200 with 200 PDFs (about 90 PDFs total). math.stanford.edu not used (TLS). Many other web.stanford.edu/class/mathNNN pages (53h, 113, 120, 171, 220a) are 200 HTML but link no PDFs (Canvas). K. Conrad (math.stanford.edu/~conrad) course handouts and homework pages for Math 121/145/154/210B/216A/248A/248B/249/252, Vakil 216blog (FOAG notes), and Ryzhik course pages (Math 63CM, 205, 221). math.stanford.edu answers 200 to curl with TLS verification on (no robots.txt, 404), though Node earlier failed on its chain. web.stanford.edu/class/* and statweb.stanford.edu fail TLS verification from curl in this container this round (self-signed certificate in chain / 502), so no new web.stanford.edu seeds could be verified; candidates not verified: stats300b, stats311, ee377 lecture-notes pages. ~ryzhik root and ~conrad root mix research papers and are not used.
